description: Marionette v5 UI composition: Views, Regions, CollectionViews, lifecycle, and independent data, state, DOM and rendering integrations. Development source; published npm alphas can differ.
rules: Identify the installed package version and source revision before choosing documentation. This branch describes v5 development; npm alpha content may differ.
Read docs/agents.md and docs/choosing-integrations.md for task and integration decisions. Preserve an existing compatible provider; choose each adapter for its own capability.
Routing is an application integration. The router owns URLs; application code owns navigation and cancellation; Marionette owns feature and View lifecycle.
Use public package exports. Verify setup, replacement, asynchronous completion, and cleanup against the installed artifact. Do not infer measured agent gains from documentation coverage.
